title: Glowing tulip
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffdd55' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='32' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 62 Q48 75 47 92' stroke='#55cc77' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- leaf left -->
  <path d='M49 78 Q32 70 26 58 Q38 60 49 72' fill='#44bb66' stroke='#66dd88' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- leaf right -->
  <path d='M50 82 Q66 76 72 64 Q60 65 50 76' fill='#3aaa55' stroke='#55cc77' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- petals layer back -->
  <path d='M50 60 Q28 52 26 34 Q34 40 42 46 Q44 38 50 30 Q56 38 58 46 Q66 40 74 34 Q72 52 50 60 Z' fill='#ff5577' stroke='#ff99aa' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- petal left front -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q34 54 30 38 Q36 44 44 50 Q46 44 50 36 L50 58 Z' fill='#ff3355' stroke='#ff7799' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- petal right front -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q66 54 70 38 Q64 44 56 50 Q54 44 50 36 L50 58 Z' fill='#ee2244' stroke='#ff6688' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- petal center highlight -->
  <path d='M50 56 Q46 46 50 34 Q54 46 50 56 Z' fill='#ffcc55' stroke='#ffee88' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- glowing inner light -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#ffeeaa' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- base of flower -->
  <path d='M44 60 Q50 64 56 60 Q54 66 50 66 Q46 66 44 60 Z' fill='#33aa55' stroke='#55cc77' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
